symbols.name: orchard
symbols.description:
A sample SDK for working with records, collections, and paginated results.

Use [Client](symbol:orchard.client.Client) in synchronous applications, or
[AsyncClient](symbol:orchard.client.AsyncClient) in an async service. Models,
pagination helpers, and typed exceptions have their own reference pages.

This package is documentation example code. It doesn't contact a live service.
symbols.summary: A sample SDK for working with records, collections, and paginated results.

symbols.name: AsyncClient
symbols.description:
Use the records SDK from an async Python application.

Await individual operations, or use `async for` to consume a record iterator.
This example delegates to an in-memory client; no network calls are made.
symbols.summary: Use the records SDK from an async Python application.

symbols.name: Client
symbols.description:
Manage records from a synchronous Python application.

Create one client per API credential and reuse it across requests. Use
[AsyncClient](symbol:orchard.client.AsyncClient) in an async application.

The sample client keeps records in memory; it doesn't make network calls.
symbols.summary: Manage records from a synchronous Python application.

symbols.name: fetch

returns.description: The record model, or a dictionary when `raw=True`.

raises.name: ValueError
raises.description: If the record identifier is empty.

raises.name: NotFoundError
raises.description: If no record matches the identifier.

examples.code:
>>> client = Client("demo-key")
>>> record = client.fetch("rec_42")
>>> record.title
'Getting started'
>>> payload = client.fetch("rec_42", raw=True)
>>> payload["status"]
'ready'

symbols.description:
Retrieve a record by its stable identifier.

The default response is a typed [Record](symbol:orchard.models.Record).
Set `raw=True` to receive a dictionary for serialization or a legacy
integration. An explicit timeout overrides the client's default.
symbols.summary: Retrieve a record by its stable identifier.

yields.description: Records in the service's response order.

...     print(record.id, record.title)

symbols.description:
Iterate through records across every page.

Pagination is lazy: another page is read only when the iterator needs it.
Stop iteration early to avoid fetching pages your application won't use.
symbols.summary: Iterate through records across every page.
signatures: def iter_records(*, page_size: int = 20, status: RecordStatus | None = None) -> Iterator[Record]

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of records requested per page, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional processing status filter.

symbols.name: list_records

returns.description: A page of matching records with an optional continuation cursor.

raises.name: ValueError
raises.description: If the page size is outside the supported range.

examples.code:
>>> page = client.list_records(limit=10, status=RecordStatus.READY)
>>> titles = page.map(lambda record: record.title)

symbols.description:
List a single page of records with optional status filtering.

Use [iter_records](symbol:orchard.client.Client.iter_records) when you
want to read every page without managing continuation cursors.
symbols.summary: List a single page of records with optional status filtering.

symbols.description:
The API key is missing, expired, or invalid.

Refresh the credential before retrying the request. Repeating the same
request with the same invalid credential won't resolve this error.
symbols.summary: The API key is missing, expired, or invalid.

symbols.name: RateLimitError
symbols.description:
The service rejected a request because its rate limit was reached.

Wait for `retry_after` seconds before retrying. Add jitter when multiple
workers share the same credentials.
symbols.summary: The service rejected a request because its rate limit was reached.

symbols.name: Record

A record returned by the service.

Records are immutable snapshots. Fetch the record again to observe a new
processing status rather than changing its fields locally.

symbols.name: RecordStatus
symbols.description:
Processing status reported by a record.

A record moves from `pending` to `ready` after processing completes.
Failed records retain their identifier so an application can retry them.
